items.name: Utah's California Gull Extravaganza 2022

venue.name: University of Utah Union Ballroom
venue.address: 200 S, Central Campus Dr, Salt Lake City, UT 84112

items.information: # Registration is closed and the waitlist is now full. * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?app=desktop&v=dPL3eV-A0ww) will provide you with most of the information you need. * If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:30 AM. * Masks are strongly suggested to be worn throughout the duration of the competition.
